items.text: Yankees trade Brian McCann and cash to the Astros for Albert Abreu and Jorge Guzman
Braves trade Jason Heyward and Jordan Walden to the Cardinals for Shelby Miller and Tyrell Jenkins
Athletics trade Rajai Davis to the Blue Jays for Danny Farquhar and Trystan Magnuson
Rangers trade Fergie Jenkins to the Red Sox for Juan Beniquez and Steve Barr
Braves trade Dusty Baker and Ed Goodson to the Dodgers for Jim Wynn, Tom Paciorek, Lee Lacy and Jerry Royster
Yankees trade Gene Woodling, Harry Byrd, Jim McDonald, Hal Smith, Gus Triandos and Willie Miranda to the Orioles for Bob Turley, Don Larsen and Billy Hunter
Red Sox trade cash, Roy Partee, Jim Wilson, Al Widmar, Eddie Pellagrini, Pete Layden and Joe Ostrowski to the Browns for Vern Stephens and Jack Kramer
Pirates trade Adam Comorosky and Tony Piet to the Reds for Red Lucas and Wally Roettger
